C1758.title: MFA Fatigue Attacks Become a New Hacker Tactic
C1758.summary: In September 2022, security reports highlighted the growing prevalence of MFA fatigue attacks among threat actors. Attackers run scripts using stolen credentials to repeatedly log in, sending an endless stream of MFA push requests to the target's phone.
